inputs.text: Let's look at what's really happening here with this relentless assault on the working class and marginalized communities. Kerala Chief Minister Pinarayi Vijayan exposed the truth on Saturday, Mar 28, calling out the baseless attacks and politically motivated smear campaigns designed to undermine institutional reform and public welfare. Whenever grassroots cooperative systems try to build collective infrastructure to protect the working class, the corporate-backed opposition and private tech monopolies immediately cry foul—like these bogus allegations of a Rs 700 crore corruption in the Cooperative Department’s proposed common software project—to protect their own wealth and dismantle public welfare. We see right through this establishment playbook that tries to crush any movement toward true solidarity and labor rights.
